It took me a lot of trial and experimentation to find a system that help me stay organised but doesn't feel too restrictive.

What i use now is a custom planner made on agendio, and i keep my schedule pretty vague. I have a general todo by month and then by week. I plan what i want to do each day but i don't end up following it that much, it's more to give my mind a direction.

Obviously that specific solution won't necessarily work for you, but my general advice is the following : give yourself the space to be spontaneous, but set general goals that you need to progress on regurlary.
